game.name: Fifa Street 3 (Asia)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
game.desc: FIFA Street 3 on Xbox 360 is a street football game. All the great nations of the sport are present, but the novelty of this third installment lies in the new design of the title, very cartoon oriented and almost caricatured players. The game's new design is cartoonish and almost cartoonish in appearance, and you can win all the tournaments in the game with a series of tricks and victories.
